episodeTitle.en: Building a meaningful career | Jason Shah (Airbnb, Amazon, Microsoft, Alchemy)
episodeTitle.zh: 构建有意义的职业生涯 | 杰森·沙阿（Jason Shah，Airbnb、亚马逊、微软、Alchemy）

guestBioOfficial.en: Jason Shah has led product teams at Amazon, Airbnb, Microsoft, and Yammer and currently leads the product team at Alchemy (one of the most important web3 infrastructure companies). In addition, he’s an advisor, investor, and two-time founder. In today’s episode, Jason discusses what it’s like to be a PM in web3, why his role at Amazon made such a big impact on his life and career, what makes a great leader, and how to hire well. He also shares his unique perspective on building a meaningful career and life.
guestBioOfficial.zh: 杰森·沙阿曾在亚马逊、Airbnb、微软和Yammer领导产品团队，目前在Alchemy（最重要的web3基础设施公司之一）领导产品团队。此外，他还是顾问、投资者和两次创业者。今天的节目中，杰森讨论了在web3中担任产品经理的感受、他在亚马逊的角色如何对他的生活和职业生涯产生重大影响、如何成为优秀的领导者，以及如何招聘优秀人才。他还分享了他对构建有意义的职业生涯和生活的独特见解。

title.en: Building a meaningful career | Jason Shah (Airbnb, Amazon, Microsoft, Alchemy)
title.zh: 构建有意义的职业生涯 | 杰森·沙阿（Jason Shah，Airbnb、亚马逊、微软、Alchemy）

summary.en: Jason reframes 'pushback' as a negative word that puts you in a mindset of disagreeing, and instead advocates shifting direction or helping the business succeed when you disagree. He shares what it's like to be a PM in Web3 through crypto winter, how to lead a team through ups and downs while keeping morale and focus, and a wealth of advice on leadership, hiring, pushing back, working backwards, and career advancement. The episode is full of 'juicy' practical wisdom for product leaders at any stage.
summary.zh: Jason 把“pushback（顶撞/反对）”重新定义为一个负面词汇，会让人陷入“必须不同意”的心态，他主张在意见相左时改为“调整方向”或“帮助业务成功”。他分享了在加密寒冬中做 Web3 PM 是怎样的体验、如何在起伏中领导团队并保持士气与专注，以及大量关于领导力、招聘、向上管理、逆向工作与职业晋升的建议。这期节目充满对各阶段产品领导者都实用的“干货”。
